description: Open-source, fully offline wake word / keyword spotting (KWS) inference engine — ONNX/TFLite <130KB, multi-keyword, multilingual. Train a custom wake word online with auto hard-negative mining; deploy on ESP32 / Raspberry Pi / Android / Web / Windows / macOS / Linux / Home Assistant — runs on any ONNX/TFLite-capable device.
summary: Offline wake word & keyword spotting engine. One ONNX model detects multiple keywords. ONNX/TFLite, model <130KB, inference <10ms. Runs on Android, ESP32, Linux, Web, and Home Assistant (Wyoming protocol server + HA add-on). No cloud, no data usage.
